legal_base: C01-C13 plus class 01-07; twenty distinct owned codex cards validated by DeckRules at level zero
candidate_policy: Copy the current room numerical policy, enable OptionalMonsterPool only in isolated test rooms; profiles differ only in MonsterCapacity.
setup_scope: Actual original O1 monster finishing PlayCards at controlled one HP establishes Choice and one real offer. Subsequent catalog-valid server-issued offers and pile relocation are declared OFFLINE boundary fixtures, not natural route or encounter evidence.
T01: Accept at every occupancy from zero through capacity minus one. Candidate enters discard once, original hand/library/order/charge unchanged, base twenty identities retained.
T02: Full capacity replacement from hand/library/discard. Missing replacement and base-card replacement reject without any state mutation. Only selected active monster removed; new candidate enters discard; hand replacement does not draw compensation.
T03: Skip at zero occupancy and full capacity. No change to original combat, HP, shield, draw charge, RNG, inventory or base cards; only pending decision receipt and room revision change.
native_execution: Tencent cloud only with read-only shared package cache and bounded temporary output
raw_storage: Direct stream to local G drive; SHA256, gzip CRC, member counts and original row proofs before owned passed cloud copies are removed
